origin.description: Fold case so strings that differ only by case can be compared.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A character vector, or an object coerced to character.

origin.details: Case folding is locale-independent. It is not NFKC_Casefold. Dotted capital I folds to i plus a combining dot. A missing string stays missing. The string "NA" is text.
origin.example:
x <- stri_trans_casefold("İ")
cat(paste0("stri_trans_casefold of dotted capital I returns ", paste(sprintf("U+%04X", utf8ToInt(x)), collapse = " "), ".\n"))

translation.description: Fold case so strings that differ only by case can be compared.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A character vector, or an object coerced to character.

translation.details: ICU CaseMap.fold with U_FOLD_CASE_DEFAULT does the mapping. This is not str.casefold and it is not stri_trans_nfkc_casefold. Dotted capital I folds to i plus a combining dot. A missing string stays missing. The string "NA" is text.
translation.value: A string, or NA. A list returns a list. None returns an empty list.
translation.example:
from stringi.trans import stri_trans_casefold
x = stri_trans_casefold("\u0130")
shown = " ".join(f"U+{ord(char):04X}" for char in x)
print(f"stri_trans_casefold of dotted capital I returns {shown}.")
